result.answer:
If you’re in immediate danger, call 911 now. If you can, go immediately to the nearest populated public place, stay around other people, and do not go to your car, residence, or an isolated area alone.

Call or text someone you trust right now and tell them where you are. If the person keeps following you, say loudly to people nearby that you need help and that someone is following you.

If it feels safe, head into the nearest staffed building, desk, office, or security area and ask them to stay with you while emergency help is contacted. Keep your phone accessible and share your live location with someone you trust if you can.

If you want, reply with your nearest building or landmark and I can help you think through the safest next public place to move toward, but call 911 first if the threat is immediate.
